## Pull request overview This PR adds a Ruby-based JSON Schema → MDX documentation generator and seeds a Docusaurus documentation site with initial content (schema reference, IDL pages, concepts), plus CI wiring to keep generated docs from drifting. **Changes:** - Introduce `schema_doc_gen` (Ruby gem + CLIs) and `bin/chore gen schema-docs` to generate MDX schema reference pages (and an index) into `doc/docs/schemas/`. - Add Docusaurus site improvements (navbar/logo behavior, Prism language loading + YAML highlighting, new “open details on anchor” helper component). - Update several JSON Schemas with richer descriptions/examples and add CI/regress coverage for schema-doc generation. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 49 out of 52 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

Comments suppressed due to low confidence (5) **tools/internal-gems/schema_doc_gen/lib/schema_doc_gen/index_generator.rb:1** * scan_versions` sorts version directory names lexicographically, which will mis-order versions like `v0.10` vs `v0.2`. Parse the numeric portion and sort using a semantic version comparator (e.g., `Gem::Version.new(d.delete_prefix('v'))`) before reversing. **doc/src/components/AnchorOpenDetails/index.tsx:1** * Anchor clicks are intercepted and `preventDefault()` is called, but the URL hash is never updated. This breaks deep-linking (copy/paste URL), browser back/forward behavior, and any code relying on `location.hash`. After expanding/scrolling, update the hash (e.g., via `history.pushState`/`replaceState` or assigning `window.location.hash`) to preserve normal navigation behavior. **doc/docs/schemas/v0.2/inst_schema.mdx:1** * The “schema doc generator” link points to `tools/ruby-gems/schema_doc_gen/...`, but the generator added in this PR lives under `tools/internal-gems/schema_doc_gen/...`. This appears to be an incorrect URL baked into generated output and should be corrected in the generator template so all generated pages link to the right source. **tools/internal-gems/schema_doc_gen/schema_doc_gen.gemspec:1** * Setting `s.date` to `Time.now` makes gem builds non-reproducible. Consider omitting `s.date` (RubyGems can infer metadata) or setting it deterministically. Also, this gem ships multiple bin scripts (`bin/schema-doc-gen` and `bin/schema-docs-all`), but only one is declared in `s.executables`; if both are intended to be installed as executables, add the second as well. **tools/internal-gems/schema_doc_gen/schema_doc_gen.gemspec:1** * Setting `s.date` to `Time.now` makes gem builds non-reproducible. Consider omitting `s.date` (RubyGems can infer metadata) or setting it deterministically. Also, this gem ships multiple bin scripts (`bin/schema-doc-gen` and `bin/schema-docs-all`), but only one is declared in `s.executables`; if both are intended to be installed as executables, add the second as well.
